title: Building a Roblox game with Claude and Codex.
author: Spirited-Objective14
selftext:
Claude is very good at game mechanics etc. but when it comes to make some 3D assets I noticed Codex (Astra 6) is much faster and a bit better. 

Game is available to try if some of you would want to.  
[https://www.roblox.com/games/134380060827731/Tug-of-War-Pull-Together](https://www.roblox.com/games/134380060827731/Tug-of-War-Pull-Together)

comments.author: Ok-Comparison9250
comments.body: Hey man, every time i tell codex to make the ui, it looks awful and nothing like the references, any tips?

replies.author: Spirited-Objective14
replies.body:
Hey 👋 yes, it’s always better with a reference. I always go to ChatGPT and ask to give me 3 variations of smth (gun, buy menu, door etc etc). To get better results here in chatgpt I give smth I like from Pinterest or Dribble, anything that feels like you would like similar style.   
So with the reference I usually get nice variations from ChatGPT (of course always iterate if it’s not fully as you want) and than when you happy give it to Codex and ask to follow closely, do exact like here etc.

replies.body:
